event.title: Tunis Experiences Severe Rainfall, Classes Suspended Due to Flooding
event.canonical_title: Tunis Experiences Severe Rainfall, Classes Suspended Due to Flooding
event.summary: Tunis was hit by torrential rain and severe thunderstorms on September 17, leading to significant flooding and disruption. As a result, schools and universities suspended afternoon classes starting at 3 p.m. local time. The heavy rainfall raised concerns about further flooding and traffic disruptions in the capital.
